Colour precedence: the character's own colours, then palette, then light/dark colours, then css (later wins).

In `update_mascot()`, `theme = "original"` restores the character's own colours; `theme = NULL` leaves colours as they are.

A palette without a dark version uses its light colours in both modes; this applies to all shipped palettes.

Native and built-in palette colours give no contrast warnings. Your own colours warn below 3:1 contrast in development mode and previews; the colours are kept.
